verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev's core product is a TypeScript SDK (task.trigger(), triggerAndWait, retries, queues, realtime, etc.) that is extensively documented as the primary way developers build agentic/AI workflows, with dedicated docs for AI chat tasks and AI-native building patterns, plus community confirmation of using it as a code-first SDK in production apps. Missing for 10: independent third-party SDK benchmarking/review, and no OpenAPI/REST API spec found (only SDK+CLI+MCP), so full API surface documentation is slightly incomplete.
